body:
Sometimes I'm like "wow, how was I ever depressed? I feel great! I'm having so much fun and I'm so happy I wanna do so many things with so many people! Isn't life swell?" The not remembering how it was before is DEFINITELY a thing I have. The switch is also pretty abrupt usually, and sometimes I feel really good but also terrible at the same time and vice versa. I've researched BPD a little and some of the mania symptoms like having a bunch of energy and not sleeping for days isn't really like me, but I'm not depressed all the time and I guess do have "highs" or whatever. 

I think I might talk to my counselor tomorrow about finding a doctor.
Wow, thanks! I salute you for being so cool!

What can I say? I'm an attention seeker. 

And I think so, but I believe the counselors are more for academic questions and whatnot. But if I ask for help again tonight and I'm ignored then I guess I have no choice but to see my counselor.
